findings.evidence: String.lean:129 `j ∈ weightString M halpha mu ↔ genWeightSpace M ((mu + j • alpha : Dual K H) : H → K) ≠ ⊥` vs Trace.lean:226 `... genWeightSpace M ((χ : H → K) + j • (α : H → K)) ≠ ⊥ := fun _ => mem_weightString_iff hα χ`; mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Module/LinearMap/Defs.lean:834 `LinearMap.coe_add`, :755 `LinearMap.coe_smul`.
findings.fix: Add an explicit coercion lemma next to `mem_weightString_iff`, e.g. `theorem coe_add_nsmul (mu alpha : Dual K H) (j : ℕ) : ((mu + j • alpha : Dual K H) : H → K) = (mu : H → K) + j • (alpha : H → K) := by simp` (`LinearMap.coe_add` and `LinearMap.coe_smul` are both simp/rfl in Mathlib), and `rw`/`simp only` with it in `hmem` and before applying `hN`, so one spelling appears in the statement.
findings.issue: `hmem` (line 225-226) and the application of `hN` at line 227 typecheck only through definitional unfolding of the coercion: `mem_weightString_iff`/`exists_genWeightSpace_add_nsmul_eq_bot_of_le` state `((χ + j • α : Dual K H) : H → K)` while the trace lemmas need `(χ : H → K) + j • (α : H → K)`. The comment acknowledges this but leaves it as unfolding-dependent glue, and the theorem statement itself then mixes the two spellings, so every downstream use of `mem_weightString_iff` (a simp lemma in the `Dual` spelling) hits the same mismatch.

findings.evidence: Trace.lean:174 and Trace.lean:240 are character-identical after the leading rewrite; Trace.lean:187-188 and 192-193 differ only in how `hN i _` is discharged. `TauCeti/Algebra/Lie/Submodule/Finrank.lean` already exists as the LieSubmodule/Submodule finrank bridge and is imported at Trace.lean:8.
findings.fix: Extract `theorem finrank_eq_zero_of_eq_bot {N : LieSubmodule R L M} (h : N = ⊥) : finrank R N = 0` into the already-imported `TauCeti/Algebra/Lie/Submodule/Finrank.lean` and use it at both sites; hoist the base case as `have hbase : ∀ i, N ≤ i → trace K _ (raiseLowerEnd M hx hy (χ + i • α)) = ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i+1) N, ...` before the induction and close both branches with it.
findings.issue: The four-step chain `rw [..., ← finrank_toSubmodule, LieSubmodule.bot_toSubmodule, finrank_bot, zero_smul]` is written twice, at line 174 (`hterm`) and line 240, in two different sections; this is exactly the kind of named-lemma chain that breaks on a Mathlib rename (`bot_toSubmodule`). Separately, the base-case block `rw [raiseLowerEnd_eq_zero hx hy (hN i _), map_zero, Finset.Ico_eq_empty (by omega), Finset.sum_empty]` is duplicated at lines 187-188 and 192-193.

summary: Proofs are mostly robust and readable (no change/show, explicit simp only, abel/omega). Two issues: the string section crosses the `Dual K H` → `H → K` coercion by bare definitional unfolding instead of a rewrite lemma, and two rewrite blocks are duplicated verbatim rather than factored.
